title: M5 Execution Identity and Idempotency Architecture

dispatch_attempt_id.scope: Single physical dispatch attempt to an executor adapter

executor_task_id.scope: Executor host daemon private task identifier
executor_task_id.boundary: TERMINATES AT ADAPTER BOUNDARY; never canonical identity

correlation_id.scope: Traceability across entry surfaces and adapters

idempotency_identity.rule: Same key + same fingerprint -> REPLAY; same key + changed fingerprint -> CONFLICT

retry_and_resume_semantics.pre_dispatch_retry: Creates a new dispatch attempt with new dispatch_attempt_id after revalidating package
retry_and_resume_semantics.task_resume: Resumes existing suspended task using original canonical_task_id and adapter handle
retry_and_resume_semantics.redispatch: Explicit new dispatch requiring fresh package_id and fresh dispatch_attempt_id
